full.free_text:
Secondary school teacher (Science), 10 years, CBSE school in Jaipur.
- Teach physics and chemistry to classes 9 and 10; prepare lesson plans, worksheets and lab practicals.
- Set and correct unit tests and term exams, keep marks records and write report cards.
- Give extra classes to weak students and prepare toppers for board exams and olympiads.
- Meet parents every term and handle classroom discipline as class teacher.
B.Sc, B.Ed.

partial.free_text: B.Ed student doing my internship. I taught class 7 science for four weeks under a mentor teacher and made two lesson plans and a working model.

other.free_text: Warehouse supervisor, 6 years: receiving goods, managing pickers, stock counts in SAP and dispatch planning.
